Best service to others: constant attempt to share the love of the Creator as known to the inner self; general answer for any seeker, and unique to each
Unique talents, no best way, each entity's own discernment
The healer must be balanced first; healing is first practiced upon the self
Dysfunction may prohibit the intended service (65.3); aim is to lighten the planetary vibration, light and love go where sought (65.11); functions given once the forgetting is penetrated (65.12)
Difficulty of adjustment (12.30, 66.34) and the helping presence (65.12) as two things that travel together
Forgetting makes love authentic, staggering courage of the surrender

Burden: love too large for the vessel; gift: love does not diminish, the call can be answered again; lightening the planetary vibration (65.11). Closing: You are loved.
